title: Polite attention phrases
explanation: Use a short polite word before asking for help. Disculpe is the safest general choice in this module. Oiga can attract attention, but keep it polite and follow with a clear request.

title: Asking for help with ¿Puede ayudarme?
explanation: ¿Puede ayudarme? is a polite fixed question meaning Can you help me? Use it when you need help from another person. It is a question, so it keeps Spanish question marks.

title: Necesito for simple needs
explanation: Necesito means I need. At A0, use it with one clear thing: necesito ayuda, necesito un médico, necesito la policía. Do not use it for long explanations yet.

title: Communication repair requests
explanation: When you do not understand, say no entiendo. Then ask for one clear action: repita, por favor or hable más despacio, por favor. These are fixed polite requests in this module.

title: Asking where an important service is
explanation: Use the known pattern ¿Dónde está...? to ask where an important place is. In this module, the places are el baño, la farmacia and el hospital.

title: Simple emergency requests
explanation: For urgent help, keep the sentence short and direct. Use necesito with médico or policía, or say es una emergencia. The app does not teach broad emergency conversation yet.
